misc: Known for deliberating his next shot for a long time, leading to somewhat slow play
biography: Panu, a competitor who participated in three editions of the Hector Trophée, inscribed his name into the tournament's history with a notable team victory.

His record includes one occasion where his pairing successfully claimed the coveted Hector Trophée. This achievement highlights his capacity for strategic partnership within the challenging format. Despite this team success, the prestigious Victor Trophy, recognizing individual excellence, remained an accolade he did not secure during his appearances.

Panu was distinctive on the course for his deeply considered approach, often pausing to meticulously deliberate each shot. This characteristic, which could lead to an unhurried pace of play, underscored a thorough and analytical mind, intent on perfecting every aspect of his game.

As the Hector Trophée 2026 approaches, Panu has concluded his active involvement in Hector events and will not be among this year's field. His impactful, albeit concise, history with the tournament, distinguished by a hard-fought team triumph, will remain a part of its esteemed legacy.
